scientific_limitations_integrity: Normal-order statement is in natural density for each fixed prime ell; no uniformity in ell or explicit exceptional-set rate. Proof uses standard Mertens-in-progressions, Turan-Kubilius, Brun-Titchmarsh, and Markov estimates. Independent audit has not been performed.
title: Normal order of prime-adic valuations of the sum-of-divisors function
